preflight.B5BeforeNativeLoad: Validate explicit selected SDK/profile manifest, file hashes, requirements, configuration, runtime placement and actual binding assembly; no ancestor or adjacent same-name override.
preflight.B4AfterRuntimeLoad: Compare runtime query to selected identity before session/API use.
preflight.B4ModuleLoad: OS image loader necessarily runs before an exported function can be queried. Compare SDK ID/compiler/STL/CRT/config/profile/C API before any factory/Describe/Build callback. Preserve previous selected factory and existing leases on refusal.
preflight.limit: This does not prevent DllMain/static initializer effects or promise security/rollback for arbitrary external effects. Optional pre-load PE metadata inspection would require a separate accepted contract amendment; it is not silently claimed.

identity.queryLengthContract: pixie_sdk_identity returns full UTF-8 byte length excluding NUL (maximum 65535); capacity0 probes length without writing; a null buffer with capacity0 is valid. Positive capacity requires nonnull buffer and always NUL terminates bounded truncation. Negative capacity, null buffer with positive capacity, or internal oversize identity returns -1 and sets pixie_last_error. No session or GL context required. Test capacity1, exact size, undersize, invalid arguments, no overwrite and repeat stability.
identity.comparison: compare the canonical typed nativeMatchFields projection, not whole manifest/runtime/module JSON or byte order. Exclude files/tool availability and per-module candidateContract. Refuse missing/unknown/malformed/oversized identities before C++ callbacks; module identity UTF-8 string is bounded to 65535 bytes under the cooperative module contract.
identity.capabilityAdmission: report actual native facilities; shipping is not an admitted Editor authoring host even if preserved fallback candidate functions exist; no blanket custom-type admission
